sloka: एक: पालयते लोकमेक: पालयते कुलम् ।मज्जत्येको हि निरय एक: स्वर्गे महीयते ॥ २.१०९.१५॥
transliteration: eka: pālayate lokameka: pālayate kulam ।majjatyeko hi niraya eka: svarge mahīyate ॥ 2.109.15॥

translations.english: One protects the world. Another runs his family. One plunges into hell. Another is honoured in heaven. (These are the fruits of truth and untruth).
